description.html: The sand scoop with a sieve (model NT-45 Sand Shovel on the packaging) is a tool for everyday terrarium cleaning. It has a round frame with fine mesh and a long handle. When you scoop up substrate, clean sand falls back through the mesh into the terrarium, while droppings, food leftovers and larger debris stay in the scoop.

The packaging describes it as a lightweight, durable scoop for sifting sand and soil. Regular cleaning keeps the substrate hygienic for longer, reduces odours and means you replace the substrate less often.

It is best to check the terrarium every day and remove droppings straight away, especially with desert species on sand. Shake the scoop gently over the substrate so the sand passes through the mesh, then discard the waste. Lift out wet clumps of substrate whole, as they will not pass through the mesh.

After use, wash the scoop in warm water and let it dry before the next use. The mesh is meant for dry, loose substrates; it is less useful with chunky bark or moss. See terrarium substrates in our equipment range.
